In `app/session.py`, I set `PRECOMPACT_MIN_CONTEXT_PCT` to 30 and added a class constant `CODEX_PRECOMPACT_MIN_CONTEXT_PCT = 5`. I also replaced the old comment with one giving the 30% rationale. `_precompact_policy` now returns 30 for both `min_context_pct` and `arm_threshold` on Claude sessions. Codex sessions return 5 for both, read from the new constant.

I haven't run any code or tests. A re-grep of the file shows each backend's policy referencing its own constant, and no other file mentions these constants. To check it independently, build a Claude session and a Codex session and call `_precompact_policy()` on each. The Claude result should show 30 and 30, and the Codex result 5 and 5.
